1.name: TEXT_CMNDEFEXPANSIONGUIDE1_00261_SYSTEM_000_001
1.description: In order to enter Ishgard, you must first meet the following requirements:
1.translation_description: Per entrare a Ishgard, devi prima soddisfare i seguenti requisiti:

2.name: TEXT_CMNDEFEXPANSIONGUIDE1_00261_SYSTEM_000_003
2.description: ※You must have completed the main scenario quest “Before the Dawn.”
2.translation_description: ※Devi aver completato la missione dello scenario principale «Prima dell’alba».

3.name: TEXT_CMNDEFEXPANSIONGUIDE1_00261_SYSTEM_000_004
3.description: ※ You must be currently undertaking the quest “Coming to Ishgard.”
3.translation_description: ※ Devi essere attualmente impegnato nella missione «Arrivo a Ishgard».

4.name: TEXT_CMNDEFEXPANSIONGUIDE1_00261_SYSTEM_000_005
